verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly show a non-interactive CI/CD-friendly install flag combo (`--skill frontend-design -g -a claude-code -y`) that skips prompts and targets an agent directly, plus `skills use ... | claude` piping the generated prompt straight to an agent headlessly. Community pushback (comm-7) questions polish of package-management features like updates/pinning but does not contradict the non-interactive install path itself. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that the -y flag suppresses all possible prompts across every source type, and no third-party report of a fully scripted end-to-end agent run.
